summary: Eight of the ten are American college football stadiums, so a typical player names Wembley, Camp Nou, Maracana and Azteca, loses a life on each and is out in six guesses. Great for a college football fan, a trap for everyone else.
reasons: Top 10 is Narendra Modi, Rungrado, then 8 US college football stadiums most players have never heard of
Every famous stadium a player thinks of first (Wembley #17, Camp Nou #12, Rose Bowl #18, Azteca #22, Bernabeu #28, MetLife #29, Maracana #66) is in the pool and costs a life
Casual sim: 1 found (Michigan) before game over on guess 6; fan sim who follows college football: 10/10 with 1 life lost
The reveal is a genuinely good fact, but it lands after the player is already out
Values match Wikipedia; #10 Bryant-Denny 100,077 vs #11 MCG 100,024 is close but not a tie
fixes: Penn State is fuzzy-corrected to Penang State Stadium (#517) and costs a life if confirmed; add 'Penn State' as an alias of Beaver Stadium
Team names are not recognized for top-10 stadiums: add 'Ohio State' (Ohio Stadium), 'LSU' (Tiger Stadium), 'Texas A&M' (Kyle Field), 'Tennessee' (Neyland Stadium), 'Alabama' (Bryant-Denny Stadium)
Melbourne Cricket Ground (#11) has no aliases; add 'MCG'
Camp Nou: add 'Nou Camp' and 'Spotify Camp Nou'; Bernabeu: display name is 'Bernabéu' and 'Santiago Bernabeu' is not recognized, add it
AT&T Stadium: 'att stadium' is not recognized; add 'ATT Stadium' / 'AT and T Stadium'

Drop junk aliases: 'Buckeye Country Superfest' (Ohio Stadium), '12th Man TV' (Kyle Field), 'Walk of Champions' (Bryant-Denny), 'Godzillatron' and 'Adzillatron' (DKR, scoreboard names), 'Salt' (Salt Lake Stadium), 'Australia' (Stadium Australia), 'Lincoln' (Memorial Stadium)
Check Camp Nou capacity: 99,354 is the pre-renovation figure; after the rebuild it is about 105,000, which would move it to #3
